headline: Sensex and Nifty Rebound to Snap 8-Day Losing Streak; Bajaj Finance and Yes Bank Lead Gains

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Indian markets snapped an eight-day losing streak with a strong opening rebound.
Bajaj Finance reported strong Q2 AUM growth, leading to bullish brokerage sentiment.
Yes Bank shares rose following a Q2 business update showing a 24% year-on-year surge in loans.
Gains in Consumer Durables and IT sectors provided early support to the indices.
whatHappening: The Sensex rallied up to 700 points while the Nifty 50 crossed the 22,600 mark in early trade.
Nifty experienced significant volatility, retreating from its morning highs to trade with reduced gains.
HDFC Bank shares gained over 1% as the broader market attempted a recovery.
Anand Rathi Wealth saw a sharp increase in futures open interest among F&O stocks.
summary: Indian markets rebounded on Monday, snapping an eight-day losing streak as the Sensex and Nifty saw significant early gains. Financial stocks like Bajaj Finance and Yes Bank led the rally following positive Q2 business updates, while HDFC Bank also traded higher. Despite the initial surge, the market remained volatile with indices paring some gains by mid-morning.
